title: Animation and Video Editing
description:
I have created several audiovisual pieces for a wide variety of projects, both personal and for third parties. I do video editing and editing, effects creation and compositing, working mainly with Premiere Pro, After Effects and CapCut. On some occasions I have combined AI-generated shots with traditional editing to achieve more complex results with more creative freedom.

I have also developed 2D and 3D animations, especially oriented to videogames. In 2D I work with techniques such as morphing, sprite sheets and frame by frame animation. In 3D I have experience in rigging, skinning, keyframe animation, cameras, lighting, materials and rendering, among other areas of the pipeline.
